19:26.text: "So eat and drink and be glad. And if you see any human being, say: ‘Verily! I have vowed a fast unto the Most Gracious
so I shall not speak to any human being this day.’"

19:27.text: to her people, carrying him. They said: "O Mary! Indeed you have brought a thing Fariyy

19:28.text: ! Your father was not a man who used to commit adultery, nor your mother was an unchaste woman."

19:29.text: Then she pointed to him. They said: "How can we talk to one who is a child in the cradle?

19:30.text: said: "Verily I am a slave of Allâh, He has given me the Scripture and made me a Prophet;

19:31.text: "And He has made me blessed wheresoever I be, and has enjoined on me Salât
, and Zakât, as long as I live."

19:32.text: "And dutiful to my mother, and made me not arrogant, unblest.

19:33.text: be upon me the day I was born, and the day I die, and the day I shall be raised alive!"

19:34.text: a statement of truth, about which they doubt

19:35.text: Allâh that He should beget a son
[this refers to the slander of Christians against Allâh, by saying that ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is the son of Allâh]
(above all that they associate with Him)
. When He decrees a thing, He only says to it: "Be!" - and it is.

19:36.text: : "And verily Allâh is my Lord and your Lord. So worship Him
(Allâh’s religion of Islâmic Monotheism which He did ordain for all of His Prophets)

19:37.text: [those who gave false witness by saying that ‘Îsâ (Jesus) is the son of Allâh]
from the Meeting of a great Day
(i.e. the Day of Resurrection, when they will be thrown in the blazing Fire)

19:38.text: (polytheists and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh)
see and hear the Day when they will appear before Us! But the Zalimûn
